payload.comment: The evaluation report indicates significant class imbalance and potential misclassification issues, particularly with the class 'colorectal adenocarcinoma epithelium'. The project should address these issues to ensure accurate model performance and prevent misclassification.
llm_issues: Ambiguity in class 'colorectal adenocarcinoma epithelium' may lead to misclassification.
Potential for dataset shift between training and test sets due to different clinical centers.
Class imbalance may affect model performance.
